electrical.logic_margin: AHC VOL<=0.1V at 50uA at 3V supply test; screen VIL<=0.15V. VOH>=2.9V at 50uA vs VIH>=2.7V. Keep total static output load <=50uA, no strong pullups or LEDs; verify edges and ground drop at FPC.

timing_default.note: Datasheet fEXTCOMIN 1-20Hz, frame 1-20Hz. Maintain COM when Linux stalls; assert DISP low on failure before stopping COM.

electrical.decoupling: Sharp example: VDDA >=0.1uF, VDD >=1uF, DISP-GND 0.1uF. Review DISP edge and sequencing with that capacitor; do not blindly add equivalent capacitance to SPI/COM. Each IC bypass 100nF, LDO input/output >=1uF effective.
electrical.sequencing: DISP low and all signal outputs benign until LCD rails valid. Start COM, clear/update panel, then DISP high. On shutdown blank/clear per Sharp timing, DISP low, isolate buffers, then remove main power. LCD input overshoot must stay within absolute limits.

power.note: Functional selection complete against defined external battery interface. Budget is conditional, not measured3A atPi. power-interface-design.md specifies downstream acceptance and no hotplug.

board_supply_reference.note: Supply recommendation including downstream USB, not measured board draw; no double-counting of native 500mA port.

power.limits: 5.6254A arithmetic is conditional, not qualification.3A includes nativeUSB and baseboard fan, no added500mA or fan counted twice. LCD/logic100mA+100mA margin yield3.2A. BelowSYS3.5V the budget is invalid; early controlled shutdown requires actual pack data. No promise of full load to2.5V pack cutoff.
power.charging: Default configured target480mA (ICHG6 x80mA),4.2V (VREG420 x10mV), only after compatible pack and sensors accepted. CE external default-disabled; POR1040mA must never reach unidentified pack. Watchdog/register reset/CC downshift fail-safe network remains schematic task.
power.input: 5V3A Type-C source target; existing conservative2.6A input limit for3A advertisement,1.2A for1.5A; unknown<=100mA/no charging. Even13W input before conversion cannot sustain16.32W design output; battery supplements, charging reduces/stops. No indefinite peak operation on external power or batteryless claim.
power.thermal: At nominal16.32W output and85% efficiency boost dissipates2.88W, before charger, switch, wiring and input losses. Needs board copper/thermal design separate from Pi heatsink; no thermal pass.
power.gpio_output_protection: Selected TPS259470LRPWR Pi branch afterTPS22990, with independentLCD branch and selected hardware latch/POR/Schmitt interlock. Reverse blocking is Pi->baseboard only; cover excludes simultaneousPiUSB-C input. Actual circuit and mechanical timing not validated.

gpio_efuse.externals: Exact supporting network remains circuit implementation: RILM,EN/UVLO,OVLO,CdVdt,CITIMER,FLT,decoupling and transient suppression. Do not infer6A upstream safety from nominal3A branch threshold. manufacturer minimumIN0.1uF/OUT1uF,ILMparasitic<50pF; fullcornerreview required.
gpio_efuse.fault_recovery: Faultlatch reset underAONsupervisorcontrol afterfaultremoved; not repeatedautomaticrestart.
gpio_efuse.qualification: ActualminimumPi voltage,sumofswitch/contactdrops,limit tolerances,thermalandstartupnotverified.5.6254Abudget remainsregulator-side conditionalbound,not proof3A arrivesatPi.

Baseline and USB-keyboard tests still required; no minimum duration. GPIOdocking protection loss is not characterized; sensitivity table unchanged, not actual runtime.

battery.dimensions_evidence: Manufacturer product 870 lacks complete pack drawing; no dimensions inferred from photograph or 21700 label.
battery.retention: Nonconductive cradle/strap, no compression or screw contact, isolate heat sources; clearance follows exact pack drawing later.
battery.polarity: Molded +/− marks and measured voltage must agree; never infer from wire color.

power.proof_boundary: Calculation assumes measured boost efficiency >=85%, SYS >=3.5V, 5.1V±2%, auxiliary <=30mA. Not a guaranteed efficiency from a typical curve; do not enable full-load operation unless validated. 10A/50ms charger peak is not a continuous rating. Pack procurement minimum 8A does not upgrade BQ25622 beyond 6A.
power.charger_input_control: BQ25622 external ILIM plus IINDPM, EN_EXTILIM enabled. TUSB320LAI reports Type-C current via I2C. Default/unknown source: no charging, conservative <=100mA input; confirmed 1.5A/3A source: nominal 1.2A/2.6A limits, full tolerance plus always-on draw below advertisement. Hardware must remain safe at boot, MCU reset, CC downshift and register reset; no BC1.2 assumption. Exact setpoint/gating network is PCB implementation work.
power.external_power_balance: Use 5V 3A Type-C source for normal light-use/charge target. At maximum combined output, available input power and 3.5A charger SW current are insufficient for unlimited operation plus charging; charging reduces/stops and battery supplements. Do not promise indefinite peak-load use or operation without battery.
power.current_guard_variant: TPS259531 moved to USB-C input; not in high-current battery path. Its 5.7V clamp is not sufficient LCD 5.5V protection.
power.thermal: At 3.3A*5.1V and 85% boost efficiency, boost losses approach 2.97W before other losses. Validate hot enclosure, copper/thermal vias, BQ BATFET loss and connector/wire heating. Not a thermally validated design.
power.temperature: Two 103AT-2; charger TS_BIAS divider plus independent MCU sensor; target charge enable 5–40C only if exact pack permits. CE pulled inactive until configuration/sensors valid; fault/watchdog fails safe. Open/short tests mandatory.
power.main_disconnect: TPS22990 VBIAS from unswitched 5.1V boost; thermal pad tied VIN, NOT GND. CT slew sized for total load capacitance. Pull ON inactive; main off before boost disable. No reverse-block or short-circuit current-limit claim.
power.charger_application: BQ25622 pins 4 ILIM, 5 TS_BIAS; use 1uH 74437349010. Reference: VBUS 1uF, PMID 10uF + 0.1uF, SYS 20uF, BAT 10uF, REGN 4.7uF, BTST-SW 47nF; effective capacitance/voltage/ESR and SYS <=500uF checked in PCB design. OTG disabled. Layout p75-77 prioritizes PMID high-frequency loop and full-length power lands; use RYK drawing, not a generic equal-pad WQFN.

runtime_budget.status: Sensitivity estimate only for candidate capacity and conservative assumed usable fraction; early SYS cutoff may change it. User 2h baseline unchanged. No USB peripherals for baseline, USB-keyboard/full-500mA runtimes separate. Existing numerical estimate remains tied to the old 3.6V candidate and must be recalculated for the final 3.7V pack; this turn does not certify capacity/runtime.

supervisor.supply: 3V3_AON via TLV75533 from BQ25622 SYS; verify dropout/headroom at lowest SYS
supervisor.bod: Enable appropriate brownout and watchdog for this voltage/clock; no 20MHz claim at 3.3V.
supervisor.gpio_budget: 16 of 18 I/O budget: UPDI 1, power key 1, request/ack/UART TX/RX 4, battery+NTC+SYS ADC 3, charger CE 1, shared charger/CC I2C 2, COM/DISP 2, main EN 1, boost EN 1. Two I/O reserved for input-limit/gating fail-safe implementation; charger status read via I2C. Exact peripheral mux and addresses reviewed in schematic. No old BQ24074 EN1/EN2/CHG allocation.
supervisor.domain_crossing: 4 x SN74LVC1G07, each powered from its sender domain; outputs pulled up only to receiving domain. Never pull Pi GPIO to always-on rail. Measure off-state leakage; no direct push-pull MCU -> unpowered Pi.

shutdown_defaults.qualification: Provisional loaded-voltage defaults for higher-current chain, not measured state of charge. SYS below 3.5V invalidates full-load power proof; shed USB load/request immediate safe shutdown while reserve remains. Controlled shutdown needs sufficient energy for Linux acknowledgement; emergency cut risks data loss. Validate thresholds/hysteresis and revise defaults from prototype, never lower user runtime goal.

supervisor.off_state: Main switch off plus boost EN off; AON low-power sleep, charging/CC remain supervised. No claim of zero battery drain.

port.connections: Pending selected non-Zero host and power topology; previous physical connector drawing remains candidate evidence only.

cooling.budget_note: 100mA allowance is not rated fan current; included inside3A Pi branch. Verify startup/running draw.
cooling.control: Baseboard routesPiGPIO12physical32 tofanPWM; red5V,blackGND frombaseboardfanbreakout. OccupiedPiheader cannot take loosefanplug simultaneously. Do not source fan current fromGPIO logic.
cooling.kit: Heatsink,3510fan,thermal pads,2xM2.5x6screws per manufacturer; no separate loose pads/screws double-counted.
cooling.dimensions_reference: product/references/pi4-fan-pwm-dimensions.jpg; preserve manufacturer drawing rather than invent a STEP or numerical envelope
cooling.mounting: Use supplied thermal pads and underside screws per manufacturer. Later enclosure retention must not collide with occupied Pi holes. Check docking socket standoff stack and fan lead access.
cooling.thermal_policy: Default fan on by60C CPU, target below75C under characterized load; these are design targets, not guarantees. Avoid no-start low PWM; use start boost/full speed and characterize. Do not trust ambiguous manufacturer demo thresholds as validated firmware.
cooling.airflow: Unobstructed inlet/exhaust, default at least5mm air gap above fan where possible; battery out of exhaust and mechanically separated from heatsink. Enclosure dimensions remain provisional.

gpio_docking.pi3v3_rule: Do not feed external3.3V intoPi rail; keep separate frombaseboardAON3.3V. Exact pin-direction/domain mapping required before circuit implementation.
gpio_docking.electrical_qualification: 5V supply pins are notGPIO logic outputs. Connector contact sharing/drop/heat unverified, no hot-plug. Power circuit must independently protect output and prevent backfeed/dual-source damage.
gpio_docking.mechanical_qualification: SupportPi on mounting posts, not socket alone. Pin1 clear marking plus guides to preventrotation or row offset. Keep heatsink/fan, USB/Ethernet, microSD and extraction access clear. NoHAT certification or allPi compatibility claim.
gpio_docking.installation: Preassembled baseboard; cold-plugPi into socket then fasten independent supports. No soldering or per-signal jumpers by user. Do not promise tool-free or hot-swap.
gpio_docking.production_footprint_evidence: product/references/ssq-footprint.pdf p1 Fig1:2rows2.54mm,20positions,1.02mmhole. ActualPCB footprint has not been built.

fan_breakout.note: Fan leads land on baseboard, not occupiedPiheader. Include fan load within existing3A compute/fan/USB budget; exact breakout connector chosen with dock.

pi_port_cover_interlock.qualification: Manufacturer pinout/application/layout reviewed for selected logic; no PCB, time-domain fault test or mechanical proof. Reset and Schmitt logic are design intent, not safety certification.

pi_power_cable.limitations: Manufacturer outer-product figures are not complete per-plug CAD drawing. Bend radius, axial plug length and loop resistance unestablished.0.5m may not fit provisional enclosure; no cable cutting default.
pi_power_cable.qualification: Target for entire3A path excluding regulator tolerance;5.1V-2%-.195V=4.803V arithmetic, not measured voltage or guaranteed cable resistance. Internal managed source port absent.

gpio_signal_harness.power_usage: signals only; Pi supply remainsUSB-C. Fan kit plugs directly onto Pi.
gpio_signal_harness.qualification: Proposed nonoverlapping Pi pin allocation, verify wiring orientation/peripheral mux and software overlays in electrical implementation. Cross-domain signals through retained open-drain buffers; never pull unpowered Pi to AON rail.
